snippet.title: Kings of Antikva - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Turn-based strategy with hidden information. Position your army, outsmart your opponent and capture the enemy flag before it’s too late. Easy to learn, hard to master. Ranked online multiplayer and offline mode versus AI.
